description: This file defines the Factory class in the OpenCart system, responsible for creating instances of controllers, models, and libraries by dynamically loading and instantiating classes based on sanitized route strings. It acts as a factory pattern implementation to manage object creation within the OpenCart framework.

classes.name: Factory
classes.description: A factory class that creates instances of controllers, models, and libraries dynamically based on provided route strings, adhering to a specific namespace and class naming convention.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Factory with a Registry instance.

methods.name: controller
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of a controller class based on the route string, or an exception if not found.

methods.name: model
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of a model class based on the route string, or an exception if not found.

methods.name: library
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of a library class with provided arguments, based on the route string, or an exception if not found.
